summary: Full re-test of the RUBIN WGC slots integration. ENV: when testing started the PHP server returned 500 everywhere (Class mysqli not found): it had started before the php8.2-mysql install finished in this fresh container. I fixed it with `supervisorctl restart frontend`. Backend 19/20 pytest pass. All writeBet kinds work in the sandbox wallet: play, bonus, tournament, jackpot and refund are ok:true with exact micro math. A bonus-buy bet of 1000 followed by four free-spin wins with bet 0 adds up correctly. insufficient_funds and an unknown kind change nothing. Idempotency and rollback work. FAIL: a sandbox tx_id that equals a real tx_id gives 500 (unique-key bug). Real E2E: writeBet 1 RUB bet / 0.5 win for rubin-1559 moved the header balance 991 -> 990.5, a repeat call was idempotent, the bet showed on the admin player page, rollback took the balance back to 991 and a repeated rollback was a no-op. The row was then deleted. Catalog: /slot shows 15891 slots. No card from a fully hidden studio appears and the provider list has none of the 17 hidden slot studios. brand=Habanero, brand=SPRIBE, q=Fazi and q=aviator all show slots-empty. Home has 9 popular slots, all Pragmatic, Hacksaw or Play'n GO. sweet-bonanza-1, gates-of-olympus-1 and book-of-dead-1 redirect to play.worldgamingconnect.com. Auto-hide: /playslot?g=judgemental-1 showed slot-error with the 'недоступна у провайдера' text, the back button goes to /slot, the DB value went 0 -> 1 and search no longer finds the game. Admin /admin/slots: wgc-probe-state shows 2123 hidden games and the studios. The probe button switches to 'Проверка идёт…', is disabled while running and polls; it finished in about 3 minutes. CRITICAL FOUND+FIXED: /admin/users had a JS SyntaxError because the `function bwAlert(msg, type) {` header was missing. This broke the Раунд, Save Changes, Ban and Manual Deposit buttons. After the fix, Раунд shows 'WGC: not_found' for a fake round. player-slot-bets and player-slot-summary rendered 4 rows correctly (Ставок 4 · 8.00 / 14.00 / +6.00), and the 'Ставки в играх (последние 50)' table is present. /admin/slotpromo: the fs-api-disabled banner shows. I created TESTFS1 on Sweet Cherry Blossom and it appeared in fs-promo-table. Activating it as the player on /bonus: the server answers 'Фриспины временно недоступны', the balance stays 991 and a failed grant row is created. BUT the player-facing toast says 'Промокод закончился или вы его уже активировали' (UI bug). I deleted the promo with fs-delete-2 and removed the grant row. Regression: registration, duplicate login rejection and the /dice page all work.

critical.issue: wgc_tx has UNIQUE KEY tx_id(tx_id), but every lookup is now scoped by is_test. If a sandbox call (test:true) uses a txId that already exists as a real tx, or a real call reuses a txId seen in sandbox, the SELECT finds nothing and the INSERT fails with 'Duplicate entry' -> 500 server_error. Reproduced: rollback test:true with transactionId 'fs-t1' gives 500. A real writeBet hitting this would make WGC retry or fail. Fix: ALTER TABLE wgc_tx DROP INDEX tx_id, ADD UNIQUE KEY tx_test (tx_id, is_test), also in admin/migrations.php.

minor.issue: It starts with UPDATE wgc_games SET rejected=0 for ALL games and only re-checks 2 games per studio. (1) For the ~3 minute run, all 2122 hidden games, including whole studios like Habanero (200 games), are visible and clickable for players. (2) Games hidden one by one by the player auto-hide (e.g. judgemental-1) are permanently UNHIDDEN by the probe. Reproduced; I restored judgemental-1 to rejected=1 by hand. Fix: compute the new set in memory or a temp column and swap it at the end, and keep player-auto-hidden rows (e.g. a separate rejected_reason / auto flag).
It recurses with no limit on HTTP 429 (sleep 3 then recursion), so a run of 429s can recurse many times. Add a retry cap.
Deleting a promo leaves its wgc_fs_grant rows orphaned (the code column shows blank in the grants table). Also, in addFsPromo the 'Выберите слот' check runs before the duplicate-code check (minor).

Every page load makes a live POST /v1/freespins {probe:true} to WGC to decide whether to show the banner. This adds latency and could create something if WGC ever enables the endpoint. Cache the result in wgc_meta.

ui_bugs.issue: On error it always shows the hardcoded toast promo3() 'Промокод закончился или вы его уже активировали' and ignores obj.error. The free-spin promo gets the correct server message 'Фриспины временно недоступны', but the player never sees it. The same applies to every other error (not found, daily limit, etc.). Fix: pass obj.error to the Noty text. The success toast is also generic and does not show 'Начислено N фриспинов в <game>'.

FIXED by testing agent: the missing 'function bwAlert(msg, type) {' line caused a SyntaxError, which killed bwRound, bwAction, bwSavePlayer and bwManualDep, so all buttons on the player page did nothing.

issues: id=userBalance is duplicated about 10 times in the page and id=error_actpromo twice (in bonus.php and in the modalSetup button). Invalid HTML that can confuse jQuery selectors.
Console errors on every page: ClipboardJS is not defined, 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Api)', null.setAttribute (pre-existing)

action_items: Change the wgc_tx unique key to (tx_id, is_test) via migrations.php. Without it, a txId collision between sandbox and real calls gives 500.
bonus.php actPromokod: show obj.error in the error toast, and the server message on success
wgc_probe: do not reset rejected=0 for all games up front (games become visible during the run), and keep games hidden by the player auto-hide
Make the frontend start script wait until the PHP extensions are installed before exec php -S (or restart after the install). The fresh container served 500s until a manual restart.
Optional: cap wgc_try_open retries on 429; deleteFsPromo should handle grants; cache the freespins-disabled check on slotpromo
critical_code_review_comments: wgc_wallet.php is sound: FOR UPDATE row locks, idempotent answers stored, rollback-before-bet tombstone, micros arithmetic. The only gap is the schema unique key vs the is_test scoping.
playslot.php auto-hide on 'not_found' could hide a game because of a temporary WGC catalog glitch. Acceptable, but note that the probe/unhide now wipes these.
sweet-bonanza-1 has fs=0 after the last sync, so it can't be chosen for new FS promos. The existing promo #1 TSTFS still points at it (WGC may refuse grants for it).

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows work except the wrong promo error toast on /bonus; admin users JS fixed)

seed_data_creation: All of it was cleaned up. Sandbox TEST_ wgc_tx rows were deleted by the fixture. The real tx TEST_real_e2e_1 and fake rows TEST_fake_0..2 for user 1559 were deleted. FS promo #2 TESTFS1 was deleted through the UI, and grant #3 (promo_id=2, user 1559) was deleted. Registered user tstreg3772 (id 1572) was deleted by id. Final state: user 1559 balance 991, wgc_tx has 1 row (fs-t1), wgc_fs_promo has 1, wgc_fs_grant has 2, and 2123 games are hidden (2122 + judgemental-1, which was re-hidden after the probe unhid it).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_rubin_wgc_callback.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. test_sandbox_rollback_does_not_touch_real_tx should pass once the wgc_tx unique key is (tx_id,is_test). Log in from the browser by setting #userLogin / #userPass and clicking #butEnter on /. If the site gives 500 'Class mysqli not found', run sudo supervisorctl restart frontend. To check the balance, read id=userBalance from the server HTML; the odometer changes the DOM.
rca of the issue: 1) users.php: during the edit that added bwRound, the 'function bwAlert(msg, type) {' line was overwritten. The leftover function body plus the extra '}' gave a parse error, so the whole <script> failed. 2) The wallet 500 happens because the tx lookups were scoped by is_test but the DB constraint was left on tx_id only. 3) The /bonus toast is legacy code (promo3) that predates the server-side error messages.
